scope: Fictional US hospital facility accounts, selected services and resource capture, USD. Simplified synthetic accounting, not GAAP, payer tariffs, tax or tenant certification.
catalog_amendment: Append five HOSPITAL_LOCAL PROCEDURE billing vocabulary rows: acute/ICU room days, ED/ambulatory attendance and extended monitored holding hours. Preserve all 3,000 accepted rows. Phase 6 permits 3,005 catalog rows. Frozen baseline artifacts remain unchanged; the explicit release-budget amendment is independently validated.
charges: Every intersecting encounter receives local room-day or facility-attendance charges. Room days use occupied local midnight, admission day inclusive and discharge day exclusive, minimum one for same-day stays; each charged date uses its actual bed responsibility center. Room prices distinguish ICU. Eligible prewindow open-AR contexts retain historical selected line context. One selected completed ancillary event per encounter is billed separately: operative case preferred, otherwise a deterministic mix of one lab result, actual medication issue or performed local procedure. Other routine services are bundled/outside selected itemization. No fabricated CPT/UB-04 or full reimbursement claim is made. Charges split at month and center. The source posting key encodes stable encounter, completion knowledge and service period.
contracts: Accepted payer allowed_factor is the prospective synthetic estimate, including explicitly discounted SELF_PAY charges. CASE_RATE/FEE_SCHEDULE descriptors do not implement DRG or Medicaid tariffs. SELF_PAY current completed visits use original patient-statement accounts in the RCM claim table; SUBMITTED means statement issued, ADJUDICATED means internal discount/responsibility confirmation, never payer transmission or payer adjudication. Insured and patient-statement populations must be selected separately. Open visits remain unclaimed. Opening SELF_PAY contexts are settled before window and carry no new opening AR; insured openings preserve historical balances.
claims: One original insured encounter claim at discharge, potentially draft at cutoff; original lines reference each charge once. In-progress visits remain unclaimed. Submission transfers net previously recognized unbilled AR into claim AR with no new revenue/GL AR. Line denial has zero economic deltas pending review. Denial reason and authorization are separate from final writeoff. Attempts share the original identity. A claim-level ADJUDICATED event covers all lines; selected partial line denials retain line references. Payer and patient liability deltas represent assigned obligations, not cash or outstanding AR. Some adjudications are partial: denied line remains unassigned until appeal. Recoveries assign only the previously unassigned amount. Historic carry-in obligations use OPENING deltas; OPENING cash/revenue/AR are zero. An immutable exported header with observed first_submitted_at is withheld until that first submission is source-known; earlier uncaptured drafts are unknown, never future actuals. Self-pay SUBMITTED is the patient statement and is excluded from all external-payer denominators.
settlements: Payments may settle payer liability partially; patient amounts remain outstanding unless a separate patient payment occurs. Refunds and payment reversals link a previous payment and carry negative cash with equal positive AR. Replacement payment is distinct and occurs later. Late, open, denied, appealed and draft states are retained. No economic event at or after cutoff is generated, including in the export grace period. Idempotent consumers deduplicate immutable event IDs and reject conflicting duplicates. Insured patient collection probability/fraction depends on obligation size: smaller balances more often pay in full, larger balances more often use partial payments. Unpaid selected balances can be explicitly forgiven after 180 days, with negative patient responsibility and positive final writeoff deltas. Partial payer remittances have later remainder settlements. These dates remain subject to cutoff; no future collection/loss is invented.
recognition: On completed eligible service period: Dr AR/Cr gross revenue, Dr contra revenue/Cr AR at prospective allowed estimate. Submission has no GL economic entry. Later contractual estimate delta: Dr contra/Cr AR (signed); recognized_revenue_delta is its negative. Credit loss writeoff: Dr OTHER_EXPENSE/Cr AR, not a cash receipt. Opening billed AR/inventory: Dr asset/Cr opening equity, no current revenue. Signed cash debits CASH/credits AR. Opening unbilled AR is zero; opening cash uses the explicit fixed treasury reserve. Historical prewindow charge intervals are excluded by service window, regardless of an earlier encounter snapshot lacking discharge. Opening claim/line snapshots first publish at the reporting-window opening; they do not expose future carry-in membership before that date.
posting_clock: Post to the source service date if source delivery is no later than day 5 of the next local month at 18:00; otherwise post to the delivery local date in the open period. For December 2025 only, grace-delivered close adjustments through January 9 post December 31. known_from and export_available_at never precede the contributing source deliveries. Cross-month source/posted bridges are retained; no synthetic balancing plug.
labor: Incremental delivered shift costs telescope to accepted final loaded_cost. Split by actual local elapsed dates with cent residuals; paid leave uses planned day. Late rate/attendance deltas are new journals. Nineteen observed unfinished shifts accrue elapsed cost less proportional planned break, without future completion. ADMIN workers have sparse quarterly attendance samples, not a complete demand roster. Integrate known effective ADMIN FTE/rate times 2080/12 by service days, then subtract captured ADMIN shift expense as known for that service month; only the salary top-up is additional expense. Late role/rate/attendance corrections produce signed true-ups. No salary is added for non-ADMIN service periods. Captured support/contractor shifts otherwise remain selected scope, not full hospital payroll.
inventory: Opening is asset/equity, receipt asset/AP, consumption expense/asset. Internal transfers and unopened returns net to zero within a facility controlled inventory account and are excluded from economic journals with an explicit zero control. Patient drug/supply consumption costs are separated from nonpatient waste. Expiry and cycle-count deltas are OTHER_EXPENSE, with linked correction/reversal effects. Purchases do not also become expense. Unit and lot valuation follow the accepted stock ledger.
overhead: Nonpatient ADMIN labor is derived from worker FTE/rate. Utilities are a declared inpatient capacity contract: licensed beds times local days times daily rate with calendar escalation; FACILITIES/AP postings retain this origin. No unmodeled hospital-wide drug, labor, professional or capital costs are implied.
allocation: Reclassify monthly direct care expense to matching pool with zero net expense. Only the pool debit/reversal is eligible. LABOR uses represented patient-hours at the responsible center; ACUTE mapped MEDICINE includes medical/surgical patient hours. Operating uses actual case minutes. Unsupported support/admin pools are NONPATIENT. DRUG uses actual linked issue quantities and lot cost (direct attribution), SUPPLY uses item/location/day consumption value and selected requirement quantity weights, never sums unlike units. Utilities allocate to IPD only; original driver is encounter-month count, selected revised runs use patient-hours. V2 explicitly supersedes V1 per posting; never add versions. Shares sum exactly to one at six places, cents use largest remainder independent of rounded shares. Empty positive driver pools go to explicit RESIDUAL; zero drivers never disappear. Allocations are analytic facts and create no new GL expense.
axiom: 11 required P&L accounts at all 45 centers monthly, 6 facility closing balance controls at ADMINISTRATION monthly, four statistics at MEDICINE/SURGERY/ICU/ED/AMBULATORY. Balance sheet values are cumulative across centers, not monthly movement. Monetary values use account normal balance. Original budgets 6 accounts/45 centers, midyear Jul-Dec 2024/2025 revisions, quarterly three-month forecasts at 12 selected centers and two accounts, budget statistics at three facility control centers. Each vintage is immutable; source_file_id/report_template_id are canonical identities only. Physical source layouts, 900-report inventory and 12-family round trips belong to Phase 7.
planning: Plans use nominal capacity, published rate assumptions and effective workforce known by publication, plus keyed uncertainty. Subsequent budgets/forecasts use only postings and resource statistics exported before publication, with completed prior months; no future realized drivers. Targets use known calendar seasonality and independent uncertainty. Revised budgets supersede original only for Jul-Dec targets. Forecasts never supersede actual. Actual first close day 5, selected December 2025 final close day 9; replacement values supersede original for identical target series only.
review_authority: Codex is the user-designated synthetic finance reviewer. Acceptance covers explicit simplified accounting, allocation and reconciliation, not independent accountant or licensed clinical endorsement.

record_budget_amendment.reason: Retain all accepted facts plus complete patient settlements, salary and boarding cost allocations. Reassign unused condition, inventory and allocation allowance; no source record or driver is truncated. Claims include separately identifiable SELF_PAY patient-statement accounts. The amended 25-table/1,995,215-row envelope remains below the two-million-record ceiling.

revenue_cycle_centers: Collections, adjudication estimate changes and credit losses post to facility ADMINISTRATION. Service recognition stays at performing center. Daily revenue journals group all charges by performing center and service_to; service_from is their minimum start and knowledge follows the latest contributing delivery. RCM daily groups cover all economic events by occurrence/delivery day and control center; linked refund/reversal receipts remain individual journals.
treasury: Fixed opening operating reserve USD 2,000,000 per facility is explicit opening CASH/equity, not inferred from a desired closing balance. Known monthly payroll obligations settle on day 10 of the following month and suppliers on day 20. These deterministic treasury journals derive from modeled liabilities; no separate hidden payroll/payment fact table is asserted. December liabilities remain unpaid at cutoff; no January 2026 cash flow is invented. Total treasury cash differs from patient-collection cash by opening funding and supplier/payroll disbursements.
authorization: Only configured elective operative/advanced diagnostic services and planned inpatient room services require authorization under a flagged payer plan. Routine ambulatory/lab/pharmacy services and emergency care do not acquire blanket prior-authorization requirements. Pre-service DENIED/EXPIRED states cause initial line denial; PENDING raises review/denial probability; otherwise a configured base documentation/clinical-review probability applies. The affected line is selected by authorization severity then expected value; expired authorization maps DEN-02, pending/denied to DEN-01. Later appeal/review can resolve coverage explicitly.
opening_payroll: The accepted resource shifts can cross the window opening. Prorated pre-2023 earned wages establish opening PAYROLL_PAYABLE against opening equity, never current labor expense. The source knowledge clock is retained; earliest posting is January 1, 2023, with later opening corrections posted when known. Opening wages known by January 10 settle that day; later corrections follow the normal next-month cycle. Current expense plus opening earned wages reconciles to captured full-shift costs, salary top-ups and closing accruals.
room_occupancy: Clinical admission can precede licensed-bed placement or end in unplaced transfer/death. Billable room dates begin at first actual physical bed placement, exclude final physical discharge day unless same-day occupancy, and never charge a wholly unplaced day. A physical transfer at midnight uses the first actual occupied bed on that date. Carry-in opening occupants do not receive an extra discharge-day minimum. Historical closed opening contexts retain declared prior billing scope; no new-period revenue is created.
holding_allocation: Unplaced intervals within an inpatient clinical admission are labor driver time, separate from physical patient-days/room billing. The holding proxy routes ED admissions to ED cost pools and other admissions to MEDICINE/ACUTE, consistent with source-author coverage. This is an explicit allocation assumption, not an invented licensed-bed occupancy or exact nurse-to-patient timesheet. IPD capacity utilities remain driven by physical patient-hours.
holding_billing: Extended monitored holding before first licensed-bed placement, or an entirely unplaced admission, has a separate local hourly service fee. The first four elapsed holding hours are bundled; only excess observed hours are billed. Split by accounting month with six-place total-hour conservation and a final micro-hour residual. A holding charge asserts care, not an occupied licensed bed. The fee awaits placement or completed-care knowledge; open care stops at the observed cutoff and stays unbilled until submission. No professional/transport charge or real payer tariff is asserted.
